annotations.title: Get this app's Fictura credentials and endpoints

description: The real values needed to wire the Fictura SDK into a codebase: the API base URL, this app's publishable SDK key (gk_…), and the RevenueCat webhook URL. ALWAYS call this before generating integration code — never leave a placeholder API key in what you write. The SDK key is publishable and safe to commit in app source; it identifies the app, not a person.
